label: Every use of 'prior' on the route stands for one and the same…, by Existential elimination…
rule: Existential elimination, uniqueness, transitivity of equality
meaning: Coverage and exclusivity block equivocation on 'prior': each use is the relation of a selected sense, and only one sense is selected, so all uses stand for one relation. The controls give a model in which coverage holds, exclusivity fails and two uses differ.
